purpose: Leakage-free sanity and runtime comparison on the unlabeled WIUT sample videos

models.task: Kinetics-400 action recognition; efficiency reference only
models.comparability_note: No public accident-trained X3D-S head was found, so its Kinetics logits must not be interpreted as accident risk or used to rank accident accuracy.

sampling.starts: 0, midpoint, and final full window, calculated from container duration without viewing frames

reported_metrics: agreement and disagreement between VideoMAE-S and VideoMAE-B
X3D-S output entropy and top-1 stability, explicitly not accident accuracy
leakage_controls: No WIUT frame is used for training, fine-tuning, calibration, checkpoint selection, threshold selection, or manual annotation.
No video frame is manually viewed before or during inference; only technical metadata is read.
Every prediction consumes only the current and earlier frames within its causal input window.
Raw scores are saved; no event threshold is selected from these videos.
Model choice is not made from this unlabeled set because accuracy cannot be measured without labels.
Inaccessible Drive files are reported as unavailable and are not replaced after inspecting results.
